stem.text: The graph shows the variation of velocity $v$ with time $t$ for an object.

stem.alt: Graph of v in m s−1 against t in s. The v axis is labelled from 0 to 24.0 and the t axis from 0 to 5.0. A straight line rises from the v axis to the upper right corner of the grid, with dashed guide lines at the top and right.

stem.text: The object passes a fixed point at time $t = 0$.
What is the displacement of the object from the fixed point at time $t = 5.0\,\text{s}$ and what is the acceleration of the object?
